description: EntityMedia is now a 24px Avatar from the avatar item: it takes Avatar's props, draws a square for a team with shape="square", and shows its AvatarFallback until an AvatarImage loads. Initials passed as children still work.

Renamed from person-mark and made composable: install entity and compose Entity, EntityMedia holding the initials or an img, EntityName and an optional EntityDescription. PersonMark's name prop and automatic initials are removed.
The docs link to this item's playground page at /playground/components/person-mark.
Assessed against the lifecycle criteria: beta, with a clean design critique.
Installs into your components folder, so import it from @/components.
Merges class names with the cn item, so a className override replaces a token utility.
Takes its initials type size from the tokens item.
